name: Power cables (LV to 500 kV)
description: XLPE-insulated power cables from 415 V building wiring through 11/33 kV distribution to 132 kV and 275 kV transmission cables, to IEC 60502 (LV/MV) and IEC 60840/62067 (HV/EHV).

specifications.metric: voltage grades covering the Malaysian system
specifications.basis: 0.6/1 kV LV through 6.35/11 and 19/33 kV MV to 132-275 kV transmission grades

specifications.metric: indicative cost, 19/33 kV 3-core Cu XLPE/SWA/PVC 95 mm2
specifications.basis: FOB China price guide at LME copper about USD 9,800-10,200/t: 19/33 kV 95 mm2 3-core copper USD 26.50-34.00/m; 240 mm2 USD 60-77/m; 400 mm2 USD 96-123/m. Aluminium conductor saves roughly 40-55%.

source.note: Sheng Cable 2026 medium-voltage price guide cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: indicative cost, 6.35/11 kV 3-core Cu XLPE/SWA/PVC 185 mm2
specifications.basis: Same price guide: 11 kV 185 mm2 copper USD 31.00-39.30/m; 95 mm2 USD 17.00-21.70/m; 300 mm2 USD 47.70-61.10/m

source.note: Sheng Cable 2026 MV price guide cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: indicative cost, 11 kV and 33 kV underground cable per km (tender-derived)
specifications.basis: Indian utility tender cost data: 33 kV 1Cx630 mm2 aluminium XLPE about USD 8,100/km; 33 kV 1Cx400 mm2 copper about USD 44,000/km; 11 kV 3x185 mm2 about USD 11,000/km; 11 kV 3x300 mm2 about USD 14,500/km. Tender-derived and useful for magnitude only.

source.note: state discom cost data cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

gaps.why: Cable ampacity needs derating by grouping, depth and soil thermal resistivity; no single datasheet value is meaningful
gaps.next_action: Record a small derated ampacity table for the common 11/33 kV sizes

gaps.why: Suppliers do not publish EHV cable prices; they are project-quoted to IEC 60840/62067
gaps.next_action: Ask owner for a Prysmian/Nexans EHV quote if a project needs it
